flags: The 2024 Visit Idaho snapshot gives 143 miles and 2 hours 27 minutes; the 2013 snapshot gives 140 miles and 3 hours. The overview uses the newer figures.
The material catalog says Idaho State Scenic Backway while its chapter says Scenic Byway; the tourism caches use Byway. No designation date or legal instrument is cached.
The cache contains no history of construction of the modern through highway. Goodale’s Cutoff is presented as a distinct older route alongside it, not as the same alignment.
Moment order is reversed from current to match material’s north-to-south strip order: Borah Peak, Arco, Craters of the Moon, onward to Carey.
The Craters cache gives youngest-flow ages of 2,000 years and about 2,100 years in different passages. Age precision is omitted.

The Loop Road note is supported by the saved secondary source only. The checked field uses the editor’s requested date, not live confirmation or a current NPS opening schedule; no closure of US 20/26/93 is implied. Cave permits and backcountry registration are outside the story’s roadside scope.
The Borah cache contains a malformed statement calling the mountain an active glacier. That statement is omitted.
